\usepackage{hyperref}
\usepackage{fancyhdr}
\usepackage{framed}
\usepackage{xcolor}

\definecolor{notecolor}{RGB}{240,240,240}
\definecolor{noteborder}{RGB}{100,100,100}

\definecolor{statusgreen}{RGB}{34,139,34}
\definecolor{statusamber}{RGB}{200,140,0}
\definecolor{statusred}{RGB}{200,40,40}

\newcommand{\OKstatus}{\textcolor{statusgreen}{\textbf{[OK]}}}
\newcommand{\WARNstatus}{\textcolor{statusamber}{\textbf{[?]}}}
\newcommand{\FAILstatus}{\textcolor{statusred}{\textbf{[X]}}}

\renewenvironment{quote}{%
  \def\FrameCommand{%
    \hspace{1pt}%
    {\color{noteborder}\vrule width 3pt}%
    {\color{notecolor}\vrule width 4pt}%
    \colorbox{notecolor}%
  }%
  \MakeFramed{\advance\hsize-\width\FrameRestore}%
  \noindent\hspace{-4.55pt}%
  \begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\vspace{2pt}%
}{%
  \vspace{2pt}\end{minipage}\endMakeFramed
}

\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\setlength{\headheight}{14pt}

\fancyhead[L]{%
  \begin{minipage}[t]{0.54\textwidth}
    \raggedright\scriptsize\href{\repoURL}{\nolinkurl{\repoURL}}
  \end{minipage}%
}
\fancyhead[R]{%
  \begin{minipage}[t]{0.44\textwidth}
    \raggedleft\scriptsize\textbf{Commit:} \href{\commitURL}{\githash}\ \textbar\ \texttt{\gitactor}
  \end{minipage}%
}

\fancyfoot[C]{\thepage}

\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0.4pt}
\renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0pt}
